features.text: ACHILLES TENDON RECOVERY: Promotes healing for tendonitis, ruptures, or post-surgical repair.
GRADUAL HEEL ADJUSTMENT: Removable wedges ensure proper plantar flexion through recovery.
HIGH-TOP IMMOBILIZATION: Protects the tendon from overstretching or reinjury.
CUSHIONED INTERIOR: Reduces post-op irritation and pressure points.
PDAC APPROVED L4361, L4360: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
